WITH cust AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerId, c.Country, AVG(i.Total) AS a
  FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.Country
),
country AS (
  SELECT Country, AVG(a) AS ca FROM cust GROUP BY Country
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ca) AS oa FROM country
)
SELECT AVG(country.ca) AS avg_country_avg, AVG(country.ca - overall.oa) AS avg_diff
FROM country JOIN overall ON overall.oa IS NOT NULL
WHERE country.ca > overall.oa
